name: Higashichichibu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashichichibu village emblem in red: a stylised device of two winged strokes flanking a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Higashichichibu, a village in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1967.

features.role: Higashichichibu village emblem — a stylised device of two winged strokes flanking a ring
